name: panda_pick_and_place_dense_v0
description: PandaGym pick-and-place benchmark where the Panda robot lifts a green cube and moves it to a blue ghost target marker.
notes: AutoresearchPandaPickAndPlaceDense-v0 delegates physics to PandaGym, recolors the non-collidable goal marker for visual clarity, and rejects reset samples that are already inside the success threshold.
The dense reward gives the outer loop a smoother learning signal than sparse pick-and-place success.
The bundled seed flattens PandaGym goal-conditioned observations for a simple SAC baseline.
